about.label: About this view
about.context_heading: A little context for the numbers
about.context_copy: GNSS is the family of satellite systems used for navigation and timing. These counts describe this collector’s public observations, not the total satellites in orbit or the sky at your location. Multiple signals from the same satellite are grouped together.
about.health_heading: Broadcast health, with reception in view
about.health_copy: “OK” is a satellite’s reported health state. It does not certify a position fix or the integrity of a receiver. Check the reception time alongside it; older broadcasts remain in the feed until they expire.

map.location_uncertain: The orbit reference is incomplete; additional satellites may be visible.
map.location_caption: Satellites above the selected horizon at this location
map.none_visible: No satellites with known positions are above this horizon.
map.cannot_locate: Cannot locate: {satellites}. These satellites remain expected; visibility at this location is unknown.
map.gap_copy_one: The tint shows the share of satellites above each location's horizon with fresh navigation observations in this audience. Red means below 50% observed; amber means 50–80%. The tint clears when at least 80% meet the station target.
map.gap_copy_two: The map asks whether satellites visible at each location are heard anywhere in this audience. It does not draw a reception radius around a station. Ground location details list every known visible satellite and its monitoring status.
map.gap_copy_three: Coverage describes monitoring of the reference satellites. It does not measure local interference, positioning accuracy, every signal, or satellite health.
map.reference_copy_one: An independent broadcast-orbit reference locates satellites that this collector may never have heard. An expired orbit remains listed as unknown instead of disappearing and making coverage look better.
map.reference_copy_two: Incomplete reference data is shown with a subtle grey tint and an explicit status. Known red and amber gaps remain visible.
map.reference_link: Orbit reference: BKG GNSS Data Center
map.access_copy: The map uses the same read permissions as the collector API. A token stays only in this tab's memory.
map.public_view: Using the collector's default read view.
map.credit: Earth image: NASA Earth Observatory / Reto Stöckli. Daylight and monitoring overlays are calculated separately.
